name: frequent-research-frontend
description: Frequent Research website: React app built with Vite. Talks to the Express backend in ../backend through /api.

scripts.prerender: node scripts/prerender.cjs dist --origin https://www.frequentresearch.com && node scripts/build-chat-kb.cjs dist public/data dist/data && node scripts/make-llms.cjs dist --origin https://www.frequentresearch.com && node scripts/phone-shell.cjs dist && node scripts/site-index.cjs dist && node scripts/compress.cjs dist
scripts.preview-file: FR_SINGLE=1 vite build --outDir dist-single && node scripts/make-preview.cjs dist-single
